user.title: Strompreis verstehen
user.description: German day-ahead electricity prices with an explanation of why the price is what it is. The data is public, no account needed. Enter your own tariff afterwards under "Configure".

development.name: Development
development.description: Only change this if you run your own copy of the API.

error.cannot_connect: The strompreis-verstehen.de server cannot be reached.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Strompreis verstehen is already set up.

init.title: My tariff
init.description: So that "My price" is right: for a dynamic tariff the surcharge is everything added to the exchange price (grid fee, taxes, levies, supplier), gross. For a time-of-use tariff (peak/off-peak) it is the energy price outside the time windows.

data_description.base_ct: Gross, in ct/kWh. The monthly base fee is not included.

time_windows.name: Time windows
time_windows.description: Up to three periods with their own price, e.g. a §14a module 3 window or off-peak hours. 22 to 6 spans midnight.

error.window_incomplete: A time window with a price needs "from" and "to".
error.window_empty: A time window has the same "from" and "to".

rate_limited.message: strompreis-verstehen.de is rate limiting, retrying later.

not_loaded.message: Strompreis verstehen is not set up or not loaded.

end_before_start.message: The latest end is before the earliest start.

no_prices_for_date.message: No prices for {date} (available: yesterday, today, and tomorrow from about 13:00).

find_cheapest_window.name: Find cheapest window
find_cheapest_window.description: Finds the cheapest continuous period of the given duration in the known prices (today and, once published, tomorrow).

config_entry.name: Entry
config_entry.description: Only needed if there are several.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the appliance runs, rounded up to quarter hours.

earliest_start.name: Earliest start
earliest_start.description: Defaults to the current quarter hour.

latest_end.name: Latest end
latest_end.description: Defaults to the last known price.

price.name: Price
price.description: Exchange price or my price with the configured tariff.

get_prices.name: Get prices of a day
get_prices.description: The quarter-hour prices of yesterday, today or tomorrow.
